question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: List the names of all product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories

question: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the price of the product named 'Wireless Mouse'?
gold_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Wireless Mouse'

question: Which products cost more than 2000? Return their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 2000

question: How many customers live in Delhi?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi'

question: What is the average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: What is the earliest customer signup date?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(signup_date) FROM customers

question: How many reviews have a rating below 3?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating < 3

question: Show the 3 most expensive products with their prices, most expensive first.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many products are in each category? Show the category name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id

question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question: Which customer has placed the most orders? Return the customer's name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: What is the average rating for each product? Show the product name and average rating.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025'

question: Which product category generated the most revenue from delivered orders? Return the category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers signed up from each country? Show the country and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: List the distinct names of customers who gave at least one 5-star review.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.rating = 5

question: What is the total quantity of 'Yoga Mat' sold across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Yoga Mat'

question: What is the most common order status?
gold_sql: SELECT status FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which products have never been ordered? Return their names.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question: For each month of 2025, how many orders were placed? Show the month as YYYY-MM and the count, in chronological order.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Which customers have spent more than 10000 in total on delivered orders? Show the name and total spend, highest spend first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING total > 10000 ORDER BY total DESC

question: Among products with at least 3 reviews, which has the highest average rating? Return the product name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of all orders were cancelled? Round to 1 decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders

question: How many customers have placed more than 3 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3)

question: What is the average order value (sum of quantity times unit price per order) across all non-cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id)

question: Which city has the highest total revenue from delivered orders? Return the city name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each category, which product sold the most units? Show the category name and product name, ordered by category name.
gold_sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT p.category_id, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT category_id, product, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY units DESC) AS rnk FROM sold) SELECT c.name, r.product FROM ranked r JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.rnk = 1 ORDER BY c.name
